modulus.critical_line: |eta_rho(K)| = 1 for all K in Z when delta = 0

unitarity_criterion.definition: A character eta: Z -> C^\times is unitary if |eta(K)| = 1 for all K in Z
unitarity_criterion.exact_theorem: eta_rho is unitary on Z <=> delta = 0

rh_equivalence.statement: Riemann Hypothesis <=> Every nontrivial zero rho induces a unitary grade character eta_rho on Z
rh_equivalence.nature: Strict reformulation of RH in the category of graded-monoid unit characters (not a proof of RH)

reflection_defect.formula: B_rho(K) = |eta_rho(K)| + |eta_rho(K)|^{-1} - 2 = tau^{K*delta} + tau^{-K*delta} - 2 = 4 * sinh^2(K * delta * log(tau) / 2)
reflection_defect.interpretation: Exact non-unitarity defect of the zero-induced grade character
reflection_defect.positivity: B_rho(K) >= 0 unconditionally; for K != 0, B_rho(K) = 0 <=> delta = 0 <=> eta_rho is unitary

positive_definite_correlation_candidates.candidate: Hilbert-space inner product C(K) = <U_K v, v>
positive_definite_correlation_candidates.spectral_nature: Spectral measure supported on the unit circle T by Herglotz's theorem

positive_definite_correlation_candidates.candidate: Zero quadratic form C_zeros(K) = sum_rho w_rho * eta_rho(K)
positive_definite_correlation_candidates.spectral_nature: Positive definite iff all eta_rho are unitary (delta_rho = 0)

positive_definite_correlation_candidates.candidate: Arithmetic prime-power correlation C_arith(K) = sum_n Lambda(n)/sqrt(n) * psi(K, log n)
positive_definite_correlation_candidates.spectral_nature: Couples zero characters to prime powers and archimedean distributions via explicit formula

arithmetic_derivation_status.geometric_side: Unconditional positivity exists for any unitary group action U_K on a Hilbert space
arithmetic_derivation_status.spectral_connection: Equating the arithmetic correlation with a pure sum of zero characters requires the explicit formula and archimedean cancellation

mellin_unitarity_status.haar_space: Multiplicative dilation T_K: f(x) |-> f(tau^K x) is strictly unitary on L^2(R_{>0}, dx/x)
mellin_unitarity_status.lebesgue_space: Normalized dilation (U_K f)(x) = tau^{K/2} f(tau^K x) is strictly unitary on L^2(R_{>0}, dx)

half_centering_status.derivation: Mellin transform of normalized dilation satisfies M[U_K f](s) = tau^{-K(s - 1/2)} M[f](s) = eta_s(K) * M[f](s)
half_centering_status.origin: The 1/2 centering is the unique shift aligning multiplicative dilation with the Lebesgue-measure Mellin-Plancherel isometry line Re(s) = 1/2

functional_equation_adjoint_status.reflection_action: eta_{1-rho}(K) = eta_rho(-K) = eta_rho(K)^{-1} (functional equation reflection corresponds to grade inversion)

herglotz_status.theorem: Herglotz (1911): C: Z -> C is positive definite iff C(K) = int_T z^K dmu(z) for a positive Borel measure mu on the unit circle T
herglotz_status.unitarity_forcing: All spectral atoms of a positive-definite sequence on Z must lie on T (|z| = 1)
herglotz_status.off_line_obstruction: Off-line zero characters have |q_rho| = tau^{-delta} != 1, so they cannot belong to the spectral support of any positive Herglotz measure

weil_comparison.justification: Deducing zero-character unitarity from arithmetic requires the zero quadratic form to be positive semi-definite, which Weil (1952) proved is equivalent to RH. TC unitarity reformulates Weil positivity in the category of graded monoid characters.

circularity_audit.caveat: The assertion that zero characters are unitary is a valid reformulation of RH, but CANNOT be used to prove RH without independently establishing the Weil positivity criterion.

corrections_to_task_tc_018.exponent_transcendence: WITHDRAWN: Gelfond-Schneider does not apply to n^{tau^{-K}} because tau^{-K} is transcendental. Counter-control alpha = log_2(3) proves alpha is transcendental yet 2^alpha = 3 is integer. Transcendence of n^{tau^{-K}} is OPEN; elementary nonintegrality (e.g. 1 < 2^{tau^{-K}} < 2) is used instead.
corrections_to_task_tc_018.ambient_closure: CORRECTED: The set A_R * tau^{A_R} is not closed under addition. The actual ambient ring is Gamma_tau = span_{A_R} { tau^K : K in A_R } (a countable algebraic-transcendental ring).

earliest_missing_implication.statement: Independent, non-circular proof that arithmetic same-referent equivalence forces the prime discrepancy functional Delta_K[psi] to dominate the archimedean tail without assuming Weil positivity.
earliest_missing_implication.next_recommended_task: TASK-TC-020: Archimedean Spectral Cancellation and Test-Function Admissibility in the TC Explicit Formula.
